b091.name: the 5-HTP trial, his version with its full stop (Y-91)
b091.text: If you're sensitive, start lower and do the trial with just 50mg 5-HTP at night for 2–3 nights, then go up to 100mg if 50mg was clearly helpful and not causing side effects. You can also add 10–20mg P5P in the morning, like Scott did, especially if the 5-HTP felt like it "almost worked," as that could be a sign it wasn't converting cleanly over to serotonin. Don't do the trial at the same time as the other suggested regimen changes (like UMP, agmatine, D-serine, psychedelics, or prescription medication changes), since the point is to see whether the 5-HTP itself is doing anything. If it's the right tool, the first things you'll usually notice are your mood or sleep quality improves, you have less nighttime rumination, and your dreams become more vivid or memorable.
